name: mcphub
description: One MCP endpoint for all your servers: a few meta-tools, Keychain secrets, sandbox, audit, OAuth.
long_description: McpHub sits between your AI client and every MCP server you use. The agent sees a few meta-tools instead of hundreds of tool definitions (about 99.9% fewer tokens), secrets live in the Keychain, servers are pinned, quarantined on change and sandboxed, every call is audited, remote servers sign in with native OAuth, and a local dashboard manages it all.
